en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a small Neo‑Gothic chapel or mausoleum in a forest. The central structure has a steep gabled roof topped with a cross, pointed‑arch doorway with decorative tracery windows, and small circular windows above. It is flanked on both sides by pergola-like arcades covered with climbing plants and vines, with long benches beneath. A path leads up a few steps to the entrance. Two seated figures in early 20th‑century clothing are visible on the benches to the left and right of the central structure. Tall coniferous trees surround the site, giving it a secluded, park‑like atmosphere. No legible printed title or caption is visible on the image.
